# Data samples from the starter package

Real rows from `data/inputs.parquet` (Fingrid and ENTSO-E, CC BY 4.0, plus calendar). **Nord Pool spot rows are deliberately excluded** (licensed: may not be shared with third parties); spot is described by its schema and monthly aggregates only, and no per-row gap (imbalance − spot) is shown.

inputs.parquet: 465,101 rows, 32 series, quarter-hours 2026-05-31T21:00Z … 2026-11-02T06:45Z. spot_nordpool.csv: 14,824 rows, same schema, series_id `fi_spot_price`, source `nordpool`.
